wording: With P49's own estimate (beta = -0.183, SE = 0.125) the reported p was reproduced (0.143) and the two-sided power to detect a moderator of that size at alpha 0.05 was only 0.31; a simulated 47-study random-effects meta-regression gave SE 0.124 and power 0.33. P49's null for allegiance is therefore weak evidence of no effect, as P49 itself cautions; by chance alone, at least 2 of 5 independent null tests would be significant 2.3% of the time.
